arm_a.answer: The request enters Flask at Flask.wsgi_app, which builds an AppContext via request_context and AppContext.from_environ. AppContext.from_environ constructs the Flask Request wrapper from app.request_class(environ), and AppContext.push loads the session and matches the route before dispatch. Flask.full_dispatch_request then runs preprocess_request, dispatch_request, finalize_request, make_response, and process_response to produce the Flask Response wrapper, and AppContext.pop finally runs do_teardown_request and do_teardown_appcontext. The core classes in this path are Flask, AppContext (the merged request/request-context object), Request, and Response.
